{{Quote|Before they were halfway to the ship, they smelled something else. Something animal, mixed with something not-animal. Something that crashed loudly through the forest like a kurnbeast drunk on mattberries.|Part of Voren Na'al's report on the interview with Wicket Wystri Warrick|<ref name="GG5" />}}
'''Kurnbeasts''' were a type of creature found on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="GG5">{{WEGCite|story=The Ewok Defenses|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] interviewed the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] translating from [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. During the interview, Warrick described his [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe's]] first encounter with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and compared the noise the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] had made while moving through the forest to the sounds of a kurnbeast crashing loudly through the forest while drunk on [[Mattberry/Legends|mattberries]]. Na'al later compiled the interview into a report.<ref name="GG5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kurnbeasts were mentioned in "[[The Ewok Defenses]]," a short story written by [[Michael Stern]] and first published in ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' released by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]].<ref name="GG5">{{WEGCite|story=The Ewok Defenses|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref>
